card.name: Book review and citation punctuation
card.fires_on: Punctuation or small words at the start of a new sentence or entry in book reviews, library grade ranges (Gr 5-9) and source attributions. It fires on the period, colon, dash or space just before the review or quote text begins.

modes.label: Library review headers
modes.description: The space, dash or first word right after a grade range like Gr 5-9 in a book review.
modes.example: 197-0390-4. LC 2012000845. Gr 5-9–<<After>> a dramatic opening description of abolitionists waiting

modes.label: Attribution punctuation
modes.description: A period or colon right after a named source or author, before the quoted or described text.
modes.example: . His research has helped the field make great strides, and his work is well worth a read. - Albert Einstein<<:>> Famous the world over and possessing a name

modes.description: A small word like it or is after a book or author as subject in a description.
